description: Synthetic test data generation layer for ASRE pipeline - Faker-based factories, scenario builders, golden-file regression dataset, and integration tests covering 200+ patients with ADT, claims, auth sources including dirty/malformed records.

userStories.title: Create base patient factory
userStories.description: As a test author, I want a factory that generates realistic patient identities so that I can build multi-source scenarios around consistent patient keys.
acceptanceCriteria: tests/factories/__init__.py exists making it an importable package
tests/factories/patients.py with PatientFactory class
Generates: patient_key (MRN format), name, DOB, gender, payer_id
Accepts a seed parameter for deterministic output (default: 42)
Can generate N patients in batch via PatientFactory.batch(n, seed=42)
Default batch of 200+ patients with realistic distributions (age, gender, payer mix)
Add faker to dev dependencies in pyproject.toml
Unit tests in tests/unit/test_patient_factory.py verify determinism, field types, batch size
Typecheck passes
Tests pass

userStories.title: Create facility name pool with variants
userStories.description: As a test author, I want a pool of facility names with known aliases and variants so that I can test facility normalization and fuzzy matching.
acceptanceCriteria: tests/factories/facilities.py with FacilityPool class
Pool of ~20 canonical facilities with realistic names, NPI (valid 10-digit Luhn format), CCN, facility type (acute, LTACH, SNF, rehab, psych)
Each facility has 2-4 known aliases (abbreviations, misspellings, old names) e.g. 'St. Mary's Medical Center' / 'ST MARYS MED CTR' / 'Saint Mary's Hospital'
get_facility(index) returns a canonical facility with its aliases
get_random_alias(facility) returns one of its variant names
Some facilities (at least 2) intentionally have NO aliases to test unresolved facility path
Unit tests in tests/unit/test_facility_pool.py verify pool size, alias counts, NPI format
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: This must exist before ADT/claims/auth factories since they draw facility names from this pool.

userStories.title: Create ADT event factory
userStories.description: As a test author, I want a factory that generates raw ADT rows matching the raw_adt_events table schema so that I can test the ingest and canonicalize stages.
acceptanceCriteria: tests/factories/adt.py with ADTEventFactory class
Generates rows with columns: patient_mrn, message_ts, message_control_id, sending_facility, hl7_event, patient_class, facility_npi
Schema matches customer_config/test_customer/sources/adt_vendor_x.yaml field mappings exactly
Supports all HL7 event types: A01, A02, A03, A04, A05, A06, A07, A11, A12, A13
Patient class codes: E (ED), I (inpatient), O (observation), P (pre-admit)
message_ts timestamps are realistic (proper sequencing: admit before discharge)
sending_facility drawn from FacilityPool (using aliases for variety)
facility_npi from FacilityPool matching the facility
Accepts seed for deterministic output
Unit tests in tests/unit/test_adt_factory.py verify column names, event type coverage, timestamp ordering
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Depends on US-002 FacilityPool for facility names and NPIs.

userStories.title: Create claims event factory
userStories.description: As a test author, I want a factory that generates raw claims rows matching the raw_claims table schema so that I can test paired event emission and claims canonicalization.
acceptanceCriteria: tests/factories/claims.py with ClaimsFactory class

Generates rows with columns: member_id, admission_date, discharge_date, claim_id, facility_name, claim_type, bill_type_code, payer_code, drg_code, primary_dx, all_diagnosis_codes, billing_npi, claim_status
Schema matches customer_config/test_customer/sources/claims_clearinghouse.yaml field mappings exactly

drg_code drawn from common real MS-DRG codes (e.g., 470, 871, 291, 192, 690)
primary_dx and all_diagnosis_codes use real ICD-10-CM codes
claim_status distribution: ~85% PAID, ~10% PENDING, ~5% DENIED
admission_date < discharge_date for valid records
facility_name drawn from FacilityPool
Accepts seed for deterministic output
Unit tests in tests/unit/test_claims_factory.py verify column names, code validity, date ordering
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Depends on US-002 FacilityPool. Uses real ICD-10/DRG/UB-04 codes, not made-up ones.

userStories.title: Create dirty/malformed record generators
userStories.description: As a test author, I want factories that produce deliberately bad records so that I can test error tolerance and edge case handling.
acceptanceCriteria: tests/factories/dirty.py with corruption functions
null_field(record, field_name) — sets a required field to None, returns copy
corrupt_timestamp(record) — sets event_ts to unparseable string or future date, returns copy
reverse_dates(claims_record) — discharge_date before admission_date, returns copy
duplicate_record(record, n=2) — returns list of n exact duplicates with same source_record_id
near_duplicate(record) — same event with slightly different timestamp (within dedup tolerance), returns copy
unknown_facility(record) — facility name not in FacilityPool, returns copy
invalid_event_type(adt_record) — hl7_event set to unsupported code like Z99, returns copy
force_denied(claims_record) — sets claim_status to DENIED, returns copy
All functions return modified copy without mutating original
Each function also returns a description string of what was corrupted
Unit tests in tests/unit/test_dirty_factory.py verify each corruption type and immutability of original
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Functions operate on dict records produced by the ADT/claims/auth factories.

userStories.title: Create scenario builders - basic encounters
userStories.description: As a test author, I want pre-built scenario generators for basic healthcare encounter patterns so that I don't have to manually construct multi-event sequences.
acceptanceCriteria: tests/factories/scenarios.py with ScenarioBuilder class
simple_inpatient(patient) — ADT A01 admit + A03 discharge + matching claim
ed_to_inpatient(patient) — ADT A01(E) ED arrival + A06 OBS-to-IP + A03(I) discharge + claim
observation_stay(patient) — ADT A01(O) + A03(O) + claim with 13x bill type
cancelled_admit(patient) — A01 followed by A11 (cancel admit)
claims_only_encounter(patient) — claim with no corresponding ADT events
adt_only_encounter(patient) — ADT events with no matching claim
Each scenario returns dict with adt_rows, claims_rows, auth_rows, and expected_encounters for assertion
Unit tests in tests/unit/test_scenarios.py verify each basic scenario produces correct event types and counts
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Depends on US-003, US-004, US-005 factories. Split from complex scenarios for manageable iteration size.

userStories.title: Create scenario builders - complex encounters
userStories.description: As a test author, I want pre-built scenario generators for complex healthcare encounter patterns including transfers, readmissions, and edge cases.
acceptanceCriteria: Add to existing tests/factories/scenarios.py ScenarioBuilder class
transfer_chain(patient, n_facilities=2) — discharge from facility A, admit at facility B within transfer window
readmission(patient, days_between=15) — two separate encounters at same facility within readmission window
orphan_discharge(patient) — A03 discharge with no preceding A01 admit
multi_source_conflict(patient) — ADT and claims with mismatched timestamps (>1 hour difference)
long_stay_ltach(patient, days=45) — LTACH encounter exceeding acute stale threshold but within LTACH threshold
pre_admit_to_admit(patient) — A05 pre-admit followed by A01 admit
Each scenario returns dict with adt_rows, claims_rows, auth_rows, and expected_encounters
Unit tests in tests/unit/test_scenarios_complex.py verify each complex scenario
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Extends ScenarioBuilder from US-007 with complex multi-facility and edge case scenarios.

userStories.title: Generate the 200+ patient master dataset
userStories.description: As a test author, I want a single function that generates a complete, seeded dataset of 200+ patients with a realistic mix of encounter scenarios.
acceptanceCriteria: tests/factories/dataset.py with generate_master_dataset(seed=42, n_patients=200) function
Returns SyntheticDataset dataclass with: adt_rows (list[dict]), claims_rows (list[dict]), auth_rows (list[dict]), patients (list[dict]), expected_encounter_count (int)

Patient scenario distribution (approximate): 40% simple IP, 15% ED-to-IP, 10% observation, 8% transfers, 7% readmissions, 5% claims-only, 5% ADT-only, 3% cancelled, 3% orphan discharge, 2% multi-source conflict, 2% LTACH/SNF long stay
~10% of all records include at least one dirty/malformed element from dirty.py
Deterministic: same seed always produces identical output (test with two calls)
Total event count in range 1500-3000 rows across all sources
Generatable in under 5 seconds
Unit tests in tests/unit/test_dataset.py verify determinism, row counts, scenario distribution
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Depends on all factories (US-001 through US-008). This is the main entry point for test data generation.

userStories.title: Create curated golden-file regression dataset
userStories.description: As a test author, I want a small hand-crafted dataset with known expected outputs so that I can detect regressions in stitching, dedup, and reconciliation.
acceptanceCriteria: tests/golden/input/ directory with static JSON files: adt_events.json, claims.json, authorizations.json
tests/golden/expected/ directory with expected output: encounters.json, encounter_details.json

Covers exactly 10 patients with specific scenarios: simple IP, ED-to-IP, transfer chain (2 facilities), readmission, cancelled admit, claims-only, ADT-only, orphan discharge, multi-source conflict, observation stay
Each patient record has a _comment field explaining the scenario
Expected output includes: encounter_type, status, event count, confidence_score range, expected flags
All field names match existing source config schemas exactly
All ICD-10 codes, DRG codes, and NPIs are real/valid
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Hand-crafted static data, NOT generated by factories. The golden-file regression test that runs these through the pipeline is in US-013.

tests/utils/db_loader.py with load_synthetic_data(dataset, connection_string) function

teardown(connection_string) function drops test tables

Tests pass

userStories.title: Write integration tests using synthetic data

acceptanceCriteria: tests/integration/test_pipeline_e2e.py with tests marked @pytest.mark.integration
test_simple_inpatient_encounter — single patient, ADT + claims, verify stitched encounter
test_ed_to_ip_merge — ED arrival merges into IP encounter
test_transfer_chain — two linked encounters across facilities

test_orphan_discharge_flagged — orphan discharge gets ORPHAN_DISCHARGE flag
